company.name: Modern Health
company.shortDescription: Modern Health is a mental well-being platform for companies offering therapy, coaching, and self-guided courses.
company.description: Modern Health is a mental well-being platform for innovative companies offering therapy, coaching, and self-guided courses all in one app. The platform combines the WHO well-being assessment, self-service wellness kits, a network of certified coaches, and licensed therapists available in 35 languages all available in a seamless app. It empowers employers to charge in acknowledging that mental health is just as important as physical health, destigmatizing the conversation, and increasing the accessibility of mental health services for all.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based enterprise mental health platform that connects employees and dependents with personalized self-guided resources, coaching, therapy, group support, and crisis care.
productsAndServices.name: Modern Health Mental Health Platform

productsAndServices.description: Evidence-based virtual therapy and behavioral health care delivered by licensed providers, with care pathways that can address moderate to complex mental health needs.
productsAndServices.name: Therapy and Psychiatric Care

productsAndServices.description: One-on-one coaching from certified coaches for personal development, resilience, work-related challenges, and everyday mental well-being.
productsAndServices.name: Coaching

productsAndServices.description: Self-guided digital exercises, tools, and programs that help members build coping skills, resilience, and healthy mental well-being habits without requiring a provider match.
productsAndServices.name: Digital Resources and Self-Guided Programs

productsAndServices.description: Provider-led group sessions focused on shared mental health and workplace topics, including stress, leadership, belonging, and current events.
productsAndServices.name: Circles by Modern Health™

productsAndServices.description: 24/7 crisis resources and care navigation that help members access immediate support and escalate to appropriate clinical services when necessary.
productsAndServices.name: Crisis Support and Care Navigation

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series D round raised $74,000,000, or 44.21% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,993,427 to $1,170,000,000, a 130.1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 62 (-17 over 90 days) and market heat at 58 (-10).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Spring Health, Talkspace, Amwell.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
